definitions.clockHonesty: 1 sim-s = 60 ticks = 22.5 display-s; the match is 240 sim-seconds. Every per-match COUNT face carries the clock in its unit string; every SHARE face is clock-invariant.
definitions.strikeAttribution: BK-C2 §P.1's rule verbatim in substance: a tick on which `bkContactLedger.strikesApplied` moved by exactly one; the struck body is the ball's own `lastTouch` after the step, GATED by the body still being inside the contact law's cooldown/stun gate and by his class agreeing with the ledger's own split for that tick. Anything else is booked `strikesUnattributed` and enters no other cell.
definitions.liveFlight: the most recent release, retired when any body other than the kicker owns the ball or after 720 ticks (R9's own retire cap). A strike outside a live flight is booked in the third `bySide` slot and never enters the side or line-distance cells.
definitions.measuredGroundPass: a GROUND launch (no positive vertical component at release) of class shortPass / throughBall / cutback for which the engine itself names a target (`pendingPass.targetGid`) — so a LINE exists to price. This is exactly the population the GC term is charged on. Shots and every headed contact are named out.
definitions.loftedDelivery: a delivery whose launch HAD a positive vertical component. The GC term never enters the lofted `sL` chain (GC-T0 §SCOPE, machine-pinned), which is why this family is a control.
definitions.pairedDelta: the two arms walk the SAME seeds, and the bootstrap CLUSTER IS THE SEED: each draw resamples seeds once and re-derives BOTH arms' pooled ratios inside that draw, so the Δ interval is paired by construction. 2,000 draws, percentile interval, resample rng seeded from the block base 12524000.
honestLimits: ⚠ NO CLAIM THAT THE CAROM DISAPPEARS (contract §4): the price is a price, not a wall.
⚠ THE ARMED ARM IS ONE COMPOSITION — the world-11 stack. DV+GC double-arming is NOT measured here (no world arms both; contract §4 names it as unmeasured composition).

⚠ THE GENE IS PINNED AT 0.5 IN BOTH BATTERY ARMS, by world 11's own writer. This exam walks NO weight ladder — the gene's domain is BK-T4's question, and what a different ground weight would do is unmeasured.
⚠ THE LADDER'S ECOLOGY IS THE EXAM'S, NOT THE SHIPPED LEAGUE'S, and four league seeds is four.
⚠ THE PERF FACE IS A MACHINE READING (see `perf.method`), not a portable cost.
⚠ THE OPEN-LANE CUT IS BK-C2's EXTRACTION of the chooser's literal (BK-C2 §CORR item 5), carried here unchanged; the full lane histogram is stored so any other cut re-derives.

staleMap.note: ⭐ the chooser's OWN lane read BESIDE the SHIPPED `groundShellHazard`, both taken at the moment of choice, per arm. In the ARMED arm the hazard column is what the price actually charged; in the SHUT arm it is what the chooser was NOT charged for.
staleMap.openLaneProvenance: the ground-pass chooser's OWN gate line, anchored at src/ai/PlayerBrain.ts:595 — `if (gain > 0.15 && lane < 0.4) {`. ⚠ BK-C2 §CORR item 5 rides: at that site the literal lives in a contested-FORWARD-ball risk gate that never fires on sideways or backward passes, so 0.4 is BK-C2's chosen EXTRACTION of the chooser's literal, not a line the chooser draws over every pass. Carried, not re-argued.
staleMap.hazardProvenance: the SHIPPED predicate itself — `groundShellHazard` imported from src/ai/deliveryValueSeat.ts and CALLED with the pricer's own body set (`[team.players, opp.players]`), kicker gid and receiver gid. The observer read and the priced read are the SAME function.
staleMap.shellProvenance: the contact law's own shell, anchored at src/sim/Match.ts:5175 — `const shell = p.coreRadius + ball.radius;` inside `bkCollectBodyStrikes` — the expression `groundShellHazard` itself composes from `o.coreRadius + BALL_RADIUS`.
staleMap.choiceTick: the ARM-TIME seat (`pendingPassWindup`) wherever the shipped wind-up formed one; the RELEASE tick for the one-touch bypass that releases synchronously. The split is published per arm and the joint table is republished on the wind-up-only subset.

perf.note: ⭐ THE PERF FACE — the armed cost (GC-T0 §DEV 3's declared debt).
perf.method: each walk is timed end to end (`Date.now()` around the walk); the two arms are walked BACK TO BACK on the same seed (shut first, armed second), so scheduler/thermal drift is spread across both arms; the face is Σ wall seconds ÷ walks. ⚠ THE TIMED REGION IS THE WALK, not the engine alone — the observer's `laneOpenness` and `groundShellHazard` reads sit inside it in BOTH arms, so the DIFFERENCE is the priced chooser's cost and the LEVEL is not the game's frame cost. A MACHINE reading on one machine, never a portable number.

fidelity.note: ⭐⭐ THE INSTRUMENT-FIDELITY READ: the SHUT arm IS BK-C2's `w11` world (world-11 stack, gene 0.5, no ground price) walked on FRESH seeds, so BK-C2's published intervals are the reference lines this exam's instrument must overlap. The reference values are READ out of BK-C2's committed artifact with its bytes hashed first (canon: a dose/data-source guard hashes the bytes it reads), and asserted against the §P-frozen literals.
fidelity.rule: OVERLAP of the two 95 % intervals, not containment of the point — two bootstrap intervals from the same population overlap with very high probability, while a point-inside rule on three faces would carry a ~14 % family-wise false-red rate. Frozen before the battery, never re-cut.

walkFixtures.note: canon REFINED at #334 item 2: "anchored extraction protects the source line; a headline-bearing walk-side predicate ALSO needs a composition fixture". Every predicate that decides what a published face COUNTS is a PURE function called by BOTH the walk and this table.

ladder.note: ⭐ THE SEASON LADDER — the gene EVOLVABLE, the probe-side ladder ecology (MT-T2 / BK-T4 idiom). REPORTED, NEVER GATED as football.

arms.geneAbsent: `evolveDeliveryValue` FALSE — the DV gene set stays structurally absent, so no club has a corridor seat and BOTH corridor prices are dead. THE CONTROL; carries the NEUTRAL-DRIFT SHADOW.
arms.geneEvolvable: `evolveDeliveryValue` TRUE — the gene may enter through the SHIPPED `mutateGenome` / `crossoverGenomes` opt-in. NOTHING pre-seeded, NO weight set by hand.

ladder.doorsBothArms: both arms arm `bkGroundCorridor` AND `bkCorridorPrice` on the world-10 stack (= the world-11 flag set plus the ground door), so the door is open in both worlds and the only question is whether a coach who values the corridor can spread.
ladder.ecology: 10 teams x a single round robin (45 matches) x 20 generations x 4 league seeds x 2 arms
ladder.horizonProvenance: 20 generations is TRACED, not chosen: it is the horizon the goals-warming reference line is itself defined on (DF-C0 §R4's early(1–5)→late(16–20) slope).

selectionLaw.note: `evolveGroup`'s own band law, mirrored and anchored at its named lines. WHY probe-side: `League.finishSeason` calls the mutators with HARD-CODED options, so an evolution opt-in cannot be armed through the shipped League at all (MT-T2 precedent).

ladder.perMatchSeeds: DERIVED through the SHIPPED `hashSeed(leagueSeed, generation, fixtureIndex, 0xbc)` — the same mechanism `League.createMatch` uses. The BOOKED seeds are the league seeds (the IN-T2 / BK-T4 ladder precedent).
ladder.driftShadow: the control arm carries INERT PASSENGERS mutated by the SAME law in their OWN rng namespace and inherited through the SAME elite/mutate/reborn assignments. They touch no match, so they are what the gene level looks like with ZERO selection on it — the honest null for 「进化到底有没有采纳这个感觉」.
ladder.fitnessVisibilityQuestion: ⭐ REPORTED, NEVER GATED (the #336 §CORR 4 door): win-only fitness may simply not SEE the carom cost. The fitness–gene correlation and the drift shadow are published so the question is answerable, and nothing is nudged either way.

faces.unit: wall seconds per walked match (⚠ THIS MACHINE, THIS RUN)
faces.what: [shut] ⭐ THE PERF FACE — the armed cost, the debt GC-T0 §DEV 3 declared. METHOD, declared at §P: each walk is timed end to end with `Date.now()` around it; the two arms are walked BACK TO BACK on the same seed (shut first, armed second) so thermal/scheduler drift is spread across both arms rather than concentrated in one; the face is Σ wall seconds ÷ walks. ⚠ IT MEASURES THE WALK, NOT THE ENGINE ALONE — the observer's own `laneOpenness` and `groundShellHazard` reads are inside the timed region in BOTH arms, so the DIFFERENCE is the priced chooser's cost and the LEVEL is not the game's frame cost. A machine reading, never a portable number.
